documentary_notes: Version and Half document OFL status in upstream README/project documentation rather than relying only on a root license filename.
Typefesse is OFL 1.1; preserve designer + Velvetyne credit as an operational provenance note.
Approved families are retained as a broad library, not ranked or assigned to final product roles.

rules.approval_means: Keep in Ruthie's open font library for any future purpose; approval does not replace, rank, or finalize another font.
rules.license_gate: Open/commercial-use font license must be verified before a family is retained.
rules.provenance_gate: Retain designer/source/history provenance with the family.
rules.review_ui: YES/NO controls appear at the end of each candidate card; no MAYBE control.
rules.search_direction: Broaden into new lanes and use cases rather than escalating weirdness; include strong baselines, specialist systems, art/design/history stories, independent projects, and unusual provenance.
